run_multinode_finetune: run multinode LaViLA fine-tuning training with submitit on a SLURM cluster
submit_trainer_job: submit a Trainer job to the SLURM scheduler via submitit AutoExecutor
parse_args: parse command line arguments for multinode LaViLA fine-tuning including ngpus, nodes, and timeout
get_shared_folder: get or create the shared experiment folder path under /checkpoint for the current user
get_init_file: generate a unique init file path for distributed training process group initialization
